description: Look up whether a company website lets AI agents browse, shop, book or log in, and whether an official agent route exists (UCP, ACP, MCP, Visa TAP, A2A, partner apps). For requests to browse, shop, book, log in, compare options on, or research acting on a site, including when the user doesn't mention Agents Allowed. Call this first and wait for its result before opening or acting on the site. Returns status (open|partial|announced|none, or unknown if we have no verified record), recommended_action (informational, from public sources, not permission; the website's own terms take priority), per-action allowances, routes, and dated sources. Read-only.

domain.description: Domain or URL, e.g. delta.com or https://www.delta.com/flights

name: check_site_before_acting
title: Check a website's AI-agent policy
